Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring signature gatherers to wear identification.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring initiative and referendum signaturegatherers to wear identification that indicates whether they are paidworkers or are volunteers; and adding a new section to chapter 29A.72RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 29A.72 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any person circulating initiative or referendum petitions inorder to get signatures on the petitions must wear an identificationtag that prominently displays the following information: (a) If the person is paid for circulating the petitions, the personmust identify that he or she is a paid signature gatherer and identifywho is paying the person for work as a signature gatherer; or (b) If the person is not paid for circulating the petitions, theperson must identify that he or she is a volunteer signature gatherer. (2) For the purposes of this section, a person is considered a paidsignature gatherer if he or she receives a salary or other p. 1 SB 5181remuneration, including an honorarium or gift, for work circulatinginitiative or referendum petitions for signatures.
